description: IGO short name or identifier.
Verbatim institutional text used as input for automated extraction and matching.
Pre-processed text (case-folded, cleaned) used for matching.
Candidate keywords extracted after standardisation and stopword removal.
Frequency table (often stored as a compact key:value string) for extracted keywords.
Keyword-in-context snippets supporting each match (±30–40 characters).
Manually consolidated subset of extracted keywords used for mapping.
Automated candidate category suggestions prior to final mapping.
Flattened mapping of keywords to the final category set.
Rule or reasoning used to link keywords to categories (regex, synonym, manual confirmation).
Category-count based ordinal score for the attribute family (bounded 0–10).
Notes on edge cases, exclusions, or manual decisions taken during review.
Additional consolidation field used in later review iterations (where present).
Structured map linking consolidated keywords to triggered categories (for audit).
Highlighted KWIC evidence used for human audit (where present).
Formal year of establishment of the IGO.
Derived age calculated as 2025 - Year of Establishment.
Founding era bin used for descriptive summaries.
Density metric: number of IGOs founded within a +/- 2 year window (5-year window) around the focal IGO’s founding year.
Cumulative stock metric: running total of IGOs founded up to and including the focal IGO’s founding year.
Attribute family (e.g., Spatial_Jurisdiction, Strategies).
Canonical category label within an attribute family.
Verbatim institutional text used for matching within the Spatial Jurisdiction attribute family.
Verbatim institutional text used for matching within the Subject Matter Jurisdiction attribute family.
Verbatim institutional text used for matching within the Sources of Jurisdiction attribute family.
Verbatim institutional text used for matching within the Defined Objectives attribute family.
Verbatim institutional text used for matching within the Strategies attribute family.
Verbatim institutional text used for matching within the Defined Inter-Institutional Relationships attribute family.
Verbatim institutional text used for matching within the Vertical Coordination attribute family.
Verbatim institutional text used for matching within the Horizontal Coordination attribute family.
Subset of extracted keywords that triggered an activation for the focal category.
Raw frequency count of trigger occurrences associated with the category (pre-capping).
TF–IDF salience weight for the category’s trigger terms in the attribute-family document set.
Binary presence indicator used in the hybrid score (1 if category is present in the authoritative layer).
Category-specific tier bonus used where conceptual hierarchy applies (e.g., jurisdictional reach).
Hybrid score prior to normalisation: Presence_Bonus + min(Raw_Freq,5) + Tier_Bonus.
Reviewed ordinal (0–10) category-count score for the attribute family.
Flag indicating whether activation is supported by RAW evidence, CLEAN adjudication, or both.
Within-IGO normalised hybrid score for the category (0–10) relative emphasis within the IGO’s profile.
Across-IGO normalised hybrid score for the category (0–10) relative position in the population distribution.
IGO age in years, computed as 2025 minus YearFounded.
Composite breadth score derived from Spatial Jurisdiction category activations.
Composite breadth score derived from Subject Matter Jurisdiction category activations.
Composite breadth/formality score derived from Sources of Jurisdiction category activations.
Composite score for vertical coordination mechanisms.
Composite score for horizontal coordination mechanisms.
Diversification index (e.g., breadth or Shannon diversity) over strategy categories.
Diversification index (e.g., breadth or Shannon diversity) over objective categories.
Composite endurance index used as the outcome in Conjecture 1 tests.
